page.notes: Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The u/v spelling was normalised (Diuinam, reuocauit, euersio, seruo, saluaberis, utilitate). Italic spans are a best reading of the scan: the Scripture quotations and the passage from Gregory of Nyssa are taken to be italic, but the exact boundaries are uncertain. The accent on "aliós" is as printed and may be a damaged mark. Left and right edges show dark marks and show-through, which are not transcribed. No running head is printed on this page.
